use default

use Grid = LIST[LIST[bool]]

live_neighbours(grid: Grid, row: int, column: int) -> int is
    let count mut = 0

    for dr in -1::1 do
        for dc in -1::1 do
            if dr == 0 /\ dc == 0 then
                continue
            fi

            let r = row + dr
            let c = column + dc

            if
                r >= 0 /\ r < grid.count /\
                c >= 0 /\ c < grid[0].count /\
                grid[r][c]
            then
                count = count + 1
            fi
        od
    od

    count
si

step(grid: Grid) -> Grid is
    let next = LIST()

    for row in 0..grid.count do
        let out = LIST()

        for column in 0..grid[0].count do
            let neighbours = live_neighbours(grid, row, column)

            out.add(
                if grid[row][column] then
                    neighbours == 2 \/ neighbours == 3
                else
                    neighbours == 3
                fi)
        od

        next.add(out)
    od

    next
si

show(generation: int, grid: Grid) is
    write_line("generation {generation}")

    for row in grid do
        let cells = row |> map(alive => if alive then "#" else "." fi)

        write_line(cells |> join(""))
    od

    write_line()
si

parse(rows: string[]) -> Grid is
    let grid = LIST()

    for row in rows do
        grid.add(row |> map(c => c == '#') |> collect_list())
    od

    grid
si

// A blinker, which oscillates with period two.
let blinker mut = parse([".....", ".....", ".###.", ".....", "....."])

for generation in 0::4 do
    show(generation, blinker)

    blinker = step(blinker)
od
